text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`: this session can't run commands. I checked every change by reading it against the tests, so please run the suite to confirm it passes.

- **`search.py`**: the import pointed to a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`), so the search tests couldn't even load. It now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text`.
- **`fees.py`**: the late fee added 0.25 to the days late instead of multiplying, so 4 days gave 4.25 instead of 1.00. Changed `+` to `*`.
- **`members.py`**: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the comment and tests say members can hold five books. Set it to 5.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned one event too many. It now returns the last `n` events, and an empty list if `n` is 0 or less.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` kept the year as text, so `age()` failed. It now converts the year to a number.
- **`factory.py`**: the sample catalog was missing `Emma`, so I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`.

I didn't change any tests.
